report.summary: No evidence-supported defects found. validate_positive_integer accepts and returns positive built-in integers, rejects zero/negative integers with ValueError, and rejects bool, floats, strings, None, objects, and int subclasses with TypeError. The recorded suite shows an expected red run before implementation, followed by passing green and gate runs; an independent read-only suite rerun passed all 4 tests, and additional boundary scenarios passed. Task 1.2 remains unchanged and outside this task's scope. Document and candidate-file hashes match the packet.
